messages:
maria: heads up — bringing up Spectra-3B (v0.9) on dev/stg. doing a minimal sanity pass now. ping here if you want to follow.

alex: cool — which quant profile are we testing? int8 or int4? any special kernels?

maria: int8-qdq (fast path). please include KV cache + prefix cache checks. will run small prompt set: math, date parsing, instruction-following, tokenization edgecases, emoji boundaries.

jordan: can you paste the curl you used for the dev endpoint so i can repro locally?

maria: sure — internal curl (dev token masked):

```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://devstg.internal.redwood/models/spectra-3b/outputs" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input": "Q: What is 2+2? Explain briefly."}'
```

maria: sample reply from run: 
"4
Correct. The sum of 2 and 2 is 4." — looks fine for simple math.

leo: perf quick check: ~110ms/token on p4d-like dev node, memory ~6.5GB resident for sequence length 256, KV cache hits look stable across 10 requests.

samira: ran safety scanner against the same prompt set — no policy flags so far (L0). will run more adversarial prompts next.

alex: noticed one odd thing on date parsing tests: prompt -> "Convert 01/02/2023 to long form" produced "January 2, 2023" in some runs and "February 1, 2023" in others. might be tokenization or locale inconsistency.

maria: i reproduced. digging in — looks like tokenization boundary for leading zeros sometimes drops the 0 on detokenize which can flip month/day. dumping a small tokenization trace: 

```
Input: "01/02/2023"
Tokens: ["01","/","02","/","202","3"]
Detokenized: "1/2/2023"
```

maria: so the model sees a slightly different input internally depending on batch/kernels. likely a detokenize edge from fast path quantized tokenizer.

jordan: good catch. that would definitely explain the swap given ambiguous mm/dd vs dd/mm. alex, want to take tokenizer fastpath patch?

alex: yep i'll take it. will try to force consistent pre-tokenization and run the 100-case date suite.

deploy-bot: autosnapshot created: snapshot-2475012345-spectra3b-int8 (artifacts: toks.log, perf.csv, outputs.json)

maria: next steps: 1) alex does tokenizer fastpath fix (T: today) 2) samira runs 100-prompt regression suite incl. dates, tokenization edgecases, emojis, instruction-following (T: today/tonight) 3) leo to re-run perf with longer seqs and KV stress (T: tomorrow morning) 4) if all green, promote to dedicated-canary next week.

alex: :thumbsup: taking tokenizer. i'll post patch link and small repro after lunch — tagging @eng-platform for perf kernel visibility.

samira: scheduling the 100-prompt run now, will attach results here when done.

maria: thanks — i'll keep the thread updated. if anyone wants live pairing, i'm online for the next hour.
